coreApply.succeeded: Saved and applied to the VPN core
coreApply.partial: Saved, but core apply only partially succeeded
coreApply.partialWithError: Saved, but core apply only partially succeeded: {{error}}
coreApply.failed: Saved in the panel, but applying the config to the core failed
coreApply.failedWithError: Saved in the panel, but applying the config failed: {{error}}
coreApply.pending: Saved, but core apply is still {{status}}

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.coreHealthHint: Health of sing-box/Xray/MTProxy on the panel host, not remote proxies
dashboard.currentTrafficHint: Sum of user counters since each user's last traffic reset
dashboard.throughputHint: VPN traffic rate from the traffic-collector worker
dashboard.networkHint: Host NIC counters (OS), not VPN user accounting

tour.skipConfirmBody: Skip only this tip, cancel, or leave the whole tour.
tour.systemToggleLabel: Show spotlight tour for OWNER on first login
tour.systemToggleHint: When off, the tour never auto-starts. You can still leave this enabled and dismiss the tour in the browser.

welcome.title: Welcome to the panel
welcome.body: Access is built as Inbound → Plan → User → Subscription. Next we walk the left menu, then help you create the first pieces.

nav-dashboard.title: Dashboard
nav-dashboard.body: Traffic, online users, and host health at a glance.

nav-inbounds.title: Inbounds
nav-inbounds.body: VPN entry points: protocol and port clients connect to. Start here when adding a new protocol.

nav-plans.title: Plans
nav-plans.body: Limits and which inbounds go into a subscription profile.

nav-users.title: Users
nav-users.body: Accounts, assigned plans, and subscription links / QR codes.

nav-proxy.title: Proxies
nav-proxy.body: Local and remote nodes: status, config apply, and agent install.

nav-system.title: System
nav-system.body: Panel URL, subscription base URL, Telegram, admins, and updates.

nav-backups.title: Backups
nav-backups.body: Backup and restore the panel database.

page-inbounds.title: Inbounds list
page-inbounds.body: Here you manage entry points. Create opens the inbound editor.

page-plans.title: Plans list
page-plans.body: Here you manage plans and attach inbounds.

page-users.title: Users list
page-users.body: Here you create users and open cards for subscription links.

system-panel-url.title: Panel URL
system-panel-url.body: Public URL of this admin panel (optional; used in links and clients).

system-sub-url.title: Subscription base URL
system-sub-url.body: Public base for subscription links that clients import.

system-telegram.title: Telegram notifications
system-telegram.body: Optional alerts for apply failures and updates. Configure token and chat below.

assist-inbound.title: Create an inbound
assist-inbound.body: Create the first entry point together. Use Create now, or the highlighted button.

assist-plan.title: Create a plan
assist-plan.body: Attach inbounds and set limits. Use Create now, or the highlighted button.

assist-user.title: Create a user
assist-user.body: Assign a plan — the subscription link appears on the user card.

done.title: You are set
done.body: The menu is on the left. If setup is incomplete, the dashboard checklist will remind you.

setup.title: Initial setup
setup.guideSubtitle: See where everything lives in the menu, then create an inbound, a plan, and a user together — and share the subscription link.
setup.subtitle: Create an inbound, a plan, and a user — then share the subscription link.
setup.modelBody: An inbound is the entry point. A plan attaches inbounds and limits. A user gets a plan and a subscription link for the client.
setup.navMapBody: Use the left menu later — these are the main sections you will come back to.
setup.navDashboard: Overview of traffic, online users, and host health.
setup.navInbounds: Protocols and ports clients connect to. Start here for VPN entry.
setup.navPlans: Limits and which inbounds go into a subscription.
setup.navUsers: Accounts, plans, and subscription links / QR codes.
setup.navConfig: Raw VPN core config and apply status.
setup.navBackups: Backup and restore the panel database.
setup.whereInbound: Later: edit this under Inbounds in the left menu.
setup.wherePlan: Later: edit this under Plans in the left menu.
setup.whereUser: Later: manage users and subscription links under Users.
setup.whereDone: Subscription links always live on the user card: Users → open the user.
setup.inboundBody: An inbound is the protocol and port clients connect to. Create one here, or open the Inbounds section from the menu.
setup.inboundDone: An inbound already exists. Continue or create another one.
setup.planBody: A plan sets limits and attaches inbounds to the subscription. You will find the same form later under Plans.
setup.planDone: A plan already exists. Create another or continue.
setup.userBody: Create the first user and assign a plan. Subscription URL and QR will appear on the user card.
setup.doneBody: Copy the subscription URL or show the QR — the client will import the profile.
setup.checklistSubtitle: Inbound → plan → user. Until this is done, there is no subscription to share. Open the guide or jump to a section.

users.title: Users
users.usageChartHint: Daily series updates after the usage aggregator runs (not live).
users.deviceLimitHint: How many devices may be online at once. Without HWID, a device is a public source IP.
users.clientLinksHint: A deep link opens the subscription in the app. You can also add the HTTPS URL above manually.
users.connectionIdentitiesHint: The limit applies to concurrent online devices. Below are IPs in the stats window (a network change alone does not trip the limit if only one device is online).
users.confirmResetTraffic: Reset traffic for selected users? Counters will restart from zero.
users.confirmRotateSub: Rotate subscription URLs for selected users? Old URLs stop working immediately.
users.confirmResetOne: Reset traffic for this user? Counters will restart from zero.
users.limitsFromPlan: Limits and inbounds come from the selected plan.
users.planHint: Expiry, limits, and inbounds are applied from the plan automatically.
users.inboundsHint: Select at least one inbound — the subscription will not work without it.
users.planNoInbounds: This plan has no inbounds. Edit the plan and attach at least one inbound first.
users.noActivePlans: No active plans. Create a plan with inbounds first.
users.noAssignments: No inbound assignments found for this user
users.mtproxyHint: These links are shown only in the panel — they are not included in subscription downloads for VPN apps.

inbounds.title: Inbounds
inbounds.proxyServerEmpty: No proxy servers yet. Create one under
inbounds.displayNameTemplateHint: Client-visible name. Variables: {identity}, {username}, {tag}, {protocol}, {product}, {plan}. {protocol} is short: Hysteria2, Reality, XHTTP, gRPC…. Empty = {identity} - {tag}.
inbounds.confirmDelete: Permanently delete this inbound, its assignments, and related session/traffic history?
inbounds.secretPresent: Secret present — leave blank to keep, or enter a new value to rotate
inbounds.modeSimpleHint: Quick setup: tag, host, and protocol. Port comes from the install (Reality, Trojan, and Shadowsocks each use their own TCP port).
inbounds.installPortHint: Install publishes {{port}}/{{transport}} for this protocol. Other ports need .env and Compose changes.
inbounds.listenPortPublishedHint: Must match the port published for this protocol in the install (.env / Compose).
inbounds.xrayTlsPathsMissing: Xray needs TLS certificate files. Run `overvpn config certs` (or finish install with Nginx), recreate the API container so VPN_TLS_* is loaded, then open Detailed and set certificate paths — or paste PEM.
inbounds.xrayTlsPathsMissingShort: TLS certificate paths are missing. Configure VPN_TLS_* or paste PEM in Detailed mode.
inbounds.protocolReset: Protocol settings were reset to defaults for the new protocol.
inbounds.publicHostMissingEnv: VPN_PUBLIC_HOST is not set — enter the host manually or run overvpn config apply.
inbounds.acmeEmailHelp: Contact for Let's Encrypt certificate expiry notices. Defaults to admin@your-domain.
inbounds.obfsHelp: Masks Hysteria2 traffic (Salamander) so it is harder to detect and block. Requires the same password on server and client. Usually not needed.
inbounds.installPortRangeHint: Install publishes TCP ports {{range}} for MTProxy. Pick a free port in that range.
inbounds.mtproxyTlsDomainHint: Domain used in the ee-secret (SNI camouflage).

plans.title: Plans
plans.name: Name
plans.inboundsRequired: Select at least one inbound — otherwise subscriptions for this plan will be empty.
plans.speedLimitHint: Megabits per second. Leave empty for unlimited.
plans.trafficLimitHint: In gigabytes (GiB). Leave empty for unlimited.
plans.subscriptionTitleTemplateHint: Shown as profile-title in clients. Variables: {product}, {username}, {identity}, {plan}, {used}, {limit}, {remaining}, {upload}, {download}, {expire}, {expireDays}, {trafficBar}. Empty = OverVPN - {username}.
plans.subscriptionAnnounceHint: Optional announce text (same variables as title).
plans.subscriptionShowTrafficLimitsHint: Include total= in subscription-userinfo (traffic bar in clients). Unlimited plans send total=0 (∞). Independent of whether the user has a data quota.
plans.happProviderRequired: Enter a Happ Provider ID to edit advanced fields (info block, renew, fallback, theme).
plans.happProviderIdHint: From https://happ-proxy.com — required for advanced Happ subscription UI.
plans.subscriptionSubInfoTextHint: Blue/colored info strip (sub-info-text). Same template variables as title. Max 200 chars after render.
plans.subscriptionSubInfoButtonTextHint: Max 25 characters. Leave empty to hide the button.
plans.subscriptionSubInfoButtonLinkHint: URL or deeplink opened by the info button.
plans.subscriptionSubExpireEnabledHint: Happ shows renew UI when the subscription expires within 3 days or has expired.
plans.subscriptionSubExpireButtonLinkHint: URL or deeplink for the Renew button.
plans.subscriptionFallbackUrlTemplateHint: Backup URL if the primary fails. Variables: {token}, {subscriptionUrl}, plus the usual traffic/user vars.
plans.subscriptionColorProfileHint: Paste a color-profile JSON exported from Happ (Appearance theme).

config.title: Core configuration
config.confirmApply: Apply this configuration to the VPN core?

system.title: System
system.secretConfigured: A value is stored (leave blank to keep)
system.secretWriteOnly: Write-only — never returned by the API
system.enginesHint: Enabling a core requires a host command (overvpn enable-core). The panel cannot start Compose profiles by itself.

backups.title: Backups
backups.restoreWarning: Restore replaces live data or core configuration and can interrupt service. Database restore uses pg_restore --clean.
backups.confirmDelete: Soft-delete this backup and remove its file?

proxy.title: Proxy servers
proxy.isLocalHint: On = proxy runs next to the panel. Leave off for a remote VPS.
proxy.clientDomainHint: Where clients connect (e.g. vpn.example.com). Its A record should point at the server IP.
proxy.serverIpHint: Public IP of this node. The panel will reach the agent at port 7700.
proxy.serverIpInvalid: Enter a plain IPv4 or IPv6 address
proxy.agentBaseUrlHint: Usually built from the IP: http://IP:7700
proxy.heartbeat: How often the node says “I’m alive” (sec)
proxy.heartbeatHint: From 5 to 300 seconds. 20 is usually fine.
proxy.installCommandHint: Copy and run as root on the remote server. The token is one-time.
proxy.localNoInstall: Local proxy is already on this host — no install command needed.
proxy.wizardHint: Domain, IP/agent, and protocols for this node.
proxy.deleteConfirm: Proxy “{{name}}” will be deleted. Its entry points will be removed too.
proxy.deleteLocalForbidden: The local proxy cannot be deleted
proxy.dnsOk: Domain points at this IP — good
proxy.dnsMismatch: Domain resolves to {{addresses}}, not {{expected}}. You can continue, but clients may fail to connect.
proxy.verifyWaiting: Waiting for the agent to connect to the panel…
proxy.verifyOnline: Node is online — you can create entry points.
proxy.verifyTimeout: Still not ONLINE. Check the install command, firewall (port 7700), and panel URL.
proxy.configHint: Preview and apply the desired config on this proxy (local volumes or agent).
